caption: The drawing displays a lidded urn with a classical, vase-like shape centered within a square border. The urn has a wide body tapering into a narrower neck and sits atop a small, round pedestal on a square platform. The lid is domed, narrowing upward into a finial with a spherical tip. The body of the urn features ornate decoration: a central monogram "M" encircled by an oval garland of leaves and flowers, with additional leafy embellishments extending from the sides of the wreath. The drawing is made using graphite on light tan paper, giving a monochrome appearance dominated by varying shades of gray. In the upper left corner, there is an enlarged decorative monogram "FMG" inside an oval floral wreath. In the lower right corner, a small schematic side view of the urn is drawn, marked "Fig. 1," showing additional detail of the lid and indicating a side profile of the urn’s structure. The drawing is signed "Hester Bateman" in the lower left corner.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
